header: Data security and retention in Microsoft Defender XDR
content:
Defender XDR
10/01/2025Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR
Microsoft Defender XDR integrates with several different Microsoft security services, which
collect data using various technologies. Integrated services allow Microsoft Defender XDR to
access their data for the purpose of identifying cross-product correlations.
Customer data collected from integrated services includes processed data, such as incidents
and alerts, and configuration data, such as connector settings, rules, and so on.
Microsoft Defender XDR operates in Microsoft Azure data centers in the following
geographical regions:
European Union: North Europe and West Europe
United Kingdom: UK South and UK West
United States: East US 2 and Central US
Australia: Australia East and Australia Southeast
Switzerland: Switzerland North and Switzerland West
India: Central India and South India
UAE: UAE North and UAE Central
Once created, the Microsoft Defender XDR tenant can't be moved to a different region. Your
geographical region is shown in the Microsoft Defender portal, under Settings > Microsoft
Defender XDR > Account.
Customer data stored by integrated services might also be stored in the following locations:
The original location for the relevant service.
A region defined by data storage rules of an integrated service, if Microsoft Defender XDR
shares data with that service.
